scope: Official source pages reviewed for identity and stated scope/license; no runtime or accessibility certification. Recheck exact versions and asset rights before reuse.

resources.name: TailAdmin React free edition

resources.name: Flowbite Admin Dashboard

resources.name: Tabler

resources.caution: Not a finished brand or full application; inspect any third-party registry separately.

resources.caution: Correct primitives do not establish accessibility for the integrated application.
